references.text: The Lord chose the Levites as a substitute for all the firstborn among the Israelites, belonging to him from the day he struck down all the firstborn in Egypt.
The Levites shall be taken in place of all the firstborn among the Israelites, and the livestock of the Levites in place of all the firstborn among the livestock of the Israelites.
Take the Levites in place of all the firstborn among the Israelites; this confirms the exchange between the Levites and the firstborn.
The Levites are given to the Lord from the Israelites, taken in place of everything that opens the womb, all the firstborn among the Israelites.
Consecrate to the Lord all the firstborn, everything that opens the womb among the Israelites, both human and animal; it belongs to the Lord.
The basis for redeeming the firstborn is linked to the exodus from Egypt, when the Lord struck down all the firstborn in Egypt.
